title: Anna's Healthy Life
text:
Anna likes to be healthy. She eats fruit and vegetables every day. She drinks water when she is thirsty. She goes to bed early at night.

On Saturday, Anna goes to the park with her dog. She runs and plays for one hour. After that, she eats soup for lunch. She feels happy and strong.

questions.text: What does Anna eat every day?
Where does Anna go on Saturday?

options: She eats good food and stays active
She eats a lot of candy

questions.text: Why does Anna go to bed early?
options: Because she wants to be healthy and rested

vocabulary.definition: not sick; good for your body
plants that we can eat, such as carrots
having a lot of power in your body

paragraph_translations: A Anna le gusta estar sana. Ella come fruta y verduras todos los días. Bebe agua cuando tiene sed. Se acuesta temprano por la noche.
El sábado, Anna va al parque con su perro. Corre y juega durante una hora. Después de eso, come sopa para almorzar. Se siente feliz y fuerte.
